name: Onboarding (first-run permissions + recovery)
description: Reusable first-run permissions flow: welcome/why → checklist of what the app declares (microphone, camera, overlay, an accessibility service by class, notifications, battery-optimisation exemption), each row live and re-checked on resume, with runtime dialogs, settings hand-offs and a guided accessibility step. RecoveryState + RecoveryBanner + RecoveryScreen for a revoked permission or a stopped service (ServiceHeartbeat). "Onboarding done" persisted per app and spec version in the KV store. Ported from ActiveX's onboarding. Library API level 1, version 0.1.0.

android.note: written without a compiler; CI should compile and run :lib-onboarding:testDebugUnitTest
